positive.query: Screenshot every page of our web app, organized by user flow with notes on each screen, so we can hand it to Claude Design for a redesign.
Before we start UX optimization on our customer portal, capture all of its routes and states per persona and write a spec for each page with the screenshots.
Map the whole app, find orphan and legacy pages nobody links to, and package the screens into a design handoff for Figma.

nearMiss.query: Pick our five most impressive product screens and make polished device-framed hero images for the launch landing page.
We only have a PRD and no product yet. List every view, overlay and state the first release needs before wireframing.
Here is our current settings page; redesign it in our design system and implement the new React components.

holdout.query: Do the same full-app capture for our other product: every screen for each role, empty and error states included, packaged for our designer.

scenarios.task: We are redesigning our Next.js SaaS dashboard (about 60 routes, roles: logged out, member, workspace admin, platform superadmin) and want every page and state captured and documented for Claude Design. The repository and a local Postgres are available. Write the capture plan: environment, data and personas, route discovery, baseline, parallel area capture, per-page spec shape, packaging and the findings you will report.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline may screenshot production directly, capture only default states, skip personas, and hand over an unstructured folder of images with no specs, flows or findings.

scenarios.task: Just point the capture at our production site, create test accounts for each role there, and fill the workspace with sample data so the screenshots look populated. We have no local setup.
scenarios.baselineFailure: The baseline may create accounts and seed data in production to get populated screenshots, or propose staging or a production copy without blocking the app's third-party analytics egress or using a throwaway environment.
